messages:
Lena: Short follow-up from today's all-hands re: GTM & partners. Opening a thread to capture owners+ETAs for the asks. Please reply with OK + ETA or reassign.

Raj: Leadership wants a default mid-market pilot we can approve quickly (pricing + scope). Who owns?

Clara: Product can define feature gating for pilots. Propose two flavors: Eval-API (no private deploy) and Eval-Dedicated (staging instance). I can draft limits by Thu.

Priya: I'll own the pilot pricing matrix. Aim to have recommended price bands and conversion rules by Thu EOD.

Diego: For partner handoffs we need a one-pager: referral vs co-sell flows + readiness checklist. I'll draft Wednesday.

Tess: Legal: quick review OK but need to know thresholds for auto-convert billing. Share draft and I'll respond in 48h.

Maya: CS will supply conversion metrics and TFV definition (days to first API call + first paid). ETA Fri AM.

Raj: Also need a clear SQL rubric for PLG motions (when sales engages). Priya, can you include that with pilots?

Priya: Yes, adding SQL rubric to the same doc. Target Tue 11am for a first pass.

Clara: Note: demo infra deploy tonight 22:00 UTC may wipe staging. @deploy-bot please confirm.

deploy-bot: Reminder: staging deploy scheduled 22:00 UTC. Lock demo env 1h prior if partner demos planned.

Lena: Perfect. Owners recap: Priya (SQL + pricing) Tue 11am, Clara (feature limits) Thu, Diego (partner playbook) Wed, Maya (TFV) Fri, Tess (legal review) 48h after drafts. I'll compile into a one-pager once drafts land. :thumbsup:
